name: Identity compromise response
description: Respond to a detected account compromise (credential theft, MFA bypass, anomalous sign-in, suspicious OAuth grant, or impossible-travel signal). The playbook drives the operator through MFA reset, session revocation across IdP / SaaS, a lateral-movement hunt scoped to the compromised principal's blast radius, and a final IAM audit to remove residual persistence (rogue OAuth grants, app passwords, conditional-access exceptions). CACAO v2 + SecOps-NG content-model extensions; Sigma rule IDs are referenced under external_references — detection authoring stays upstream at SigmaHQ.

__principal_id__.description: Identity provider subject of the suspected-compromised principal (user, service principal, or workload identity).

__signal_id__.description: Identifier of the originating identity-protection / sign-in signal (e.g. Azure AD Identity Protection risk event, Okta ThreatInsight finding).

__compromise_confirmed__.description: Set by initial triage. False signals branch to a false-positive close-out path; true signals proceed to containment.

__sessions_revoked_count__.description: Number of active sessions revoked across IdP / SaaS tenants for the principal. Feeds the containment KPI.

__lateral_findings_count__.description: Distinct downstream resources or principals the compromised identity touched within the hunt window.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: triage identity signal
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Hydrate the originating identity-protection signal with principal context (role, group memberships, recent sign-ins, conditional-access posture). Decide whether the signal warrants containment or is a known benign pattern (planned travel, sanctioned automation).

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: reset MFA factors
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Force re-enrollment of MFA factors for the principal: revoke existing TOTP / WebAuthn registrations, invalidate app passwords, and require step-up at next sign-in. Document factor list pre / post reset.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: revoke active sessions
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Revoke all live sessions, refresh tokens, and persistent device grants for the principal across the IdP and downstream SaaS tenants. Produces __sessions_revoked_count__ for the containment KPI.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: lateral-movement hunt
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Hunt for downstream activity attributable to the compromised principal within the configured lookback window: STS / AssumeRole chains, cross-tenant access, API-token reuse, OAuth-grant escalation, host logons. Produces __lateral_findings_count__.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: IAM audit and persistence removal
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Audit the principal's IAM surface for residual persistence: rogue OAuth consents, third-party app grants, conditional-access exceptions, inbox rules, new device registrations, and standing-privilege role assignments. Remove anything the principal could not authorise legitimately during the compromise window.
